concurrency_and_state: NPoint (NPoint.java:240-255,1077-1142): ArrayLists tlHp/tlMp/tlDef/tlDame/tlDameAttMob/tlTNSM/tlDameCrit are cleared and repopulated in resetPoint()/setPointWhenWearClothes() without synchronization, while combat threads read getDameAttack()/setHpMax() concurrently; only increasePoint() is synchronized.
NewSkill (NewSkill.java:103-136): Spawns a dedicated java.util.Timer + thread per player special skill cast without synchronization on isActive/timer/timerTask; dispose() does not call close().
NewPet (NewPet.java:14,20-21): Static idb-- counter is non-atomic and not synchronized, risking duplicate negative entity IDs across concurrent threads.
Pet (Pet.java:102-117): goHome() mutates goingHome and status across the caller thread and GameLoopManager scheduled lambda without volatile or locking.

EffectSkin (EffectSkin.java:110-151,421-456): updateCTHaiTac() mutates itemOptions.param on other players' body items in zone without locking or calling nPoint.setDirty(); updateTrainArmor() mutates bag/box itemOptions in place.

IDMark (IDMark.java:8-319): Monolithic mutable state bag (~40 fields) tracking menus, inputs, trade partner, combine timestamps, and dungeon transitions without state-machine encapsulation or synchronization.
cross_module_questions: Does EventDAO.getRemainingTimeToIncreaseHP/MP/Dame (called in NPoint.java:812,888,1044 inside calPoint) read cached fields or execute a MySQL query on every stat recalculation?
Do Trade/Combine/Shop services enforce player-level locks around Inventory.subRuby()/subGemDirect() and IDMark.playerTradeId (int vs long Character.id)?
Does SkillService.useSkill() check skill cooldown when Pet.java:470-475 calls it for Mob ranged skill 2 without canUseSkillWithCooldown() or canAttack()?
Where is Inventory.trainArmor cleared when a player unequips, trades, drops, or sells the training armor item in bag?
How does SkillService.updateSkillSpecial() handle NewSkill.isStartSkillSpecial when NewSkill.update() unconditionally assigns isStartSkillSpecial = true?

findings.impact: Special skill update continues running after closeSkillSpecial() or races with close(), and cannot properly gate on isStartSkillSpecial == true.
findings.root_cause: Assignment operator used instead of equality comparison: `if (this.isStartSkillSpecial = true)`.
findings.title: NewSkill.update() uses assignment (=) instead of comparison (==) on isStartSkillSpecial

findings.impact: All callers of NPoint.calPercent receive 66.7% of the intended percentage value (e.g., 50% becomes 33.3%).
findings.root_cause: Both calPercent(long, int) and calPercent(int, int) divide by 150 instead of 100.
findings.title: NPoint.calPercent() divides by 150 instead of 100

findings.impact: If a caller passes a negative amount or omits pre-check, currency becomes negative or increases; inconsistent with subGemAndRuby() and subGold().
findings.root_cause: subRuby(int) and subGemDirect(int) subtract directly without checking num <= 0 or sufficient balance.
findings.title: Inventory.subRuby() and subGemDirect() lack negative-input and underflow guards

findings.impact: Punch stack bonus (+1% per punch up to tlDamePunchMax) is wiped out on every stat recalculation (every ~150ms or equip/buff).
findings.root_cause: resetPoint() sets `this.tlDamePunchMax = 0;` and immediately checks `if (this.tlDamePunchMax == 0) { this.stackDamePunch = 0; }`, which is always true.
findings.title: NPoint.resetPoint() unconditionally resets stackDamePunch to 0

findings.impact: Whenever a pet is to the left of its master (disX < 0), disX < 50 is always true, causing continuous teleportation and playerMove packet spam on every update tick.
findings.root_cause: followMaster(int dis) compares signed `disX < 50` (where `disX = this.location.x - mX`) instead of `Math.abs(disX) < 50`.
findings.title: Pet.followMaster() checks signed disX < 50, triggering infinite move/packet spam when pet is left of master

findings.impact: Thread/memory leak if player logs out during special skill, plus OS thread exhaustion under heavy special skill usage.
findings.root_cause: start() allocates a new java.util.Timer per cast without synchronization, and dispose() does not call close() to cancel timer/timerTask or clear playersTaget/mobsTaget.
findings.title: NewSkill leaks java.util.Timer threads and skips close() in dispose()

findings.impact: ConcurrentModificationException or torn/zeroed stats when combat threads read dame/hpMax/tlDame during resetPoint().
findings.root_cause: calPoint() clears and rebuilds non-synchronized ArrayLists in resetPoint()/setPointWhenWearClothes() while combat threads access NPoint without locking. Also `if (!force && !this.isDirty && (now - lastCalPointTime < 150))` still recalculates every 150ms even when !isDirty.
findings.title: NPoint.calPoint() mutates non-thread-safe lists during combat reads and recalculates when !isDirty

findings.impact: Player retains training armor dame% buff permanently after selling, dropping, trading, or banking the item; also cannot switch to a different training armor while stale reference exists.
findings.root_cause: setDameTrainArmor() caches an unequipped bag training armor in inventory.trainArmor when null and continues applying its dame bonus without verifying the item still exists in itemsBag.
findings.title: NPoint.setDameTrainArmor() retains stale inventory.trainArmor reference after item leaves bag

findings.impact: Throws ArithmeticException: / by zero if mpMax is 0 (e.g. during stat reset or before initial calPoint).
findings.root_cause: getCurrPercentMP() divides by this.mpMax without checking `if (this.mpMax == 0)` (unlike getCurrPercentHP()).
findings.title: NPoint.getCurrPercentMP() lacks zero-division guard on mpMax

findings.impact: In ATTACK mode against mobs at range, pet fires skill 2 ignoring cooldown, master idle check (canAttack), and askPea() when out of mana.
findings.root_cause: Mob ranged skill-2 branch in Pet.update() omits canUseSkillWithCooldown(), canAttack(), and else askPea() present in the PROTECT branch.
findings.title: Pet.update() ATTACK mode skips cooldown, canAttack, and askPea checks for ranged mob skill 2

findings.impact: Unnecessary network traffic every 60s per player; training armors stored after an empty slot in bag/box never lose durability/time.
findings.root_cause: updateTrainArmor() breaks loop on first empty slot (`!item.isNotNullItem()`) and unconditionally calls sendItemBags() and point() even if no trainArmor was modified.
findings.title: EffectSkin.updateTrainArmor() aborts scan at first empty slot and spams bag/point packets every 60s

findings.impact: Pet in Xayda home map (mapId 23) never patrols at home; duplicate condition at line 516 is unreachable.
findings.root_cause: GOHOME branch checks `this.zone.map.mapId == 22` twice (lines 508 and 516) instead of `== 23`.
findings.title: Pet.update() GOHOME checks mapId == 22 twice instead of mapId == 23

findings.impact: Version <= 214 gold display cap (Integer.MAX_VALUE) never triggers, potentially overflowing gold display on older clients.
findings.root_cause: Inventory.player is never initialized or assigned anywhere in Inventory, so `player != null` in getGoldDisplay() is always false.
findings.title: Inventory.player field is never assigned, making getGoldDisplay() version check dead code

findings.impact: If player IDs exceed Integer.MAX_VALUE, IDMark.playerTradeId truncates and mismatches; also fusionEffect casts long master.id to int.
findings.root_cause: Character.id is long, while IDMark.playerTradeId is typed as int (unlike long idPlayThachDau/killCharId/idEnemy).
findings.title: IDMark.playerTradeId uses int instead of long Character.id

findings.impact: Clients receive pre-damage HP/MP packets right before damage is actually applied.
findings.root_cause: updateXenHutXungQuanh() and updateOdo() call sendInfoHpMpMoney(pl) and Send_Info_NV(pl) before calling pl.injured().
findings.title: EffectSkin sends HP/MP info packets before calling pl.injured()

findings.impact: Redundant buff packet/state updates sent for every nearby player in range on a single 10s tick; incorrect message text in textBuffSD.
findings.root_cause: updateThoBulma() calls EffectSkillService.gI().setDameBuff(player, ...) inside the nearby-players loop instead of once after finding at least one target.
findings.title: EffectSkin.updateThoBulma() redundantly applies setDameBuff to self for each nearby player

findings.impact: GiftCode state is split/duplicated across Inventory.giftCode and GiftCode.rewards; NPoint.tlDameCrit and Inventory.giftCode leak in dispose().
findings.root_cause: Inventory maintains giftCode list separately from GiftCode class and omits it in dispose(); NPoint.dispose() nulls 6 lists but omits tlDameCrit.
findings.title: Duplicated GiftCode list and incomplete dispose() cleanup in Inventory and NPoint

findings.impact: Repeated map item scans and potential duplicate item drops on every tick while player is in map 183.
findings.root_cause: DropItem.update() executes ItemMapService.findItemMapByPlayer() and drops item 726 on every player update tick without any cooldown timer.
findings.title: DropItem.update() checks and drops quest item on map 183 every tick without cooldown

key_classes.name: Pet
key_classes.responsibility: AI, combat, fusion lifecycle, skill unlocking, and home/follow behavior for player disciples.

key_classes.responsibility: Periodic AoE skin/aura effects, invisibility, and training armor durability/time updates.

key_classes.name: EffectSkill

key_classes.name: NewSkill

key_classes.name: IDMark
key_classes.responsibility: Stores transient per-player NPC, menu, trade, shop, captcha, and dungeon interaction flags/timestamps.

module_summary: Core player/pet state, stat calculation, skin/skill effects, inventory, and DTO models in src/models/player and src/models/intrinsic. NPoint acts as the central stat/damage engine with additive equipment percent calculation and long-based overflow protection, while Pet, EffectSkin, EffectSkill, and NewSkill drive autonomous updates and combat/fusion state. Several high-impact gameplay and concurrency issues were observed directly in the source (NewSkill assignment bug, NPoint calPercent / 150, Pet followMaster packet spam, non-thread-safe NPoint/NewSkill timers, and missing subRuby/subGemDirect guards).

protocol_touchpoints.payload_summary: fusionEffect(int type): writeByte(type), writeInt((int) master.id); broadcast to map via sendMessAllPlayerInMap.
safeInt(long): clamps long stats to Integer.MAX_VALUE/MIN_VALUE before network writeInt serialization.
getGoldDisplay(): intended to clamp gold to Integer.MAX_VALUE for client version <= 214 (currently inactive due to null player field).
